summary: Iter17 product-review fixes verification. Signed in as bramuel@syni.ai. GREEN: (1) Trust footer renders on every authed surface (Home, Briefings verified) with ShieldCheck icon + 'Synisense-shielded' + 'Your context never leaves this account' + 'Every signal cites its source' + 'Trust centre →' link with correct href /app/settings?tab=trust (data-testid='trust-footer', 'trust-footer-link'). (2) Trust Centre deep link via /app/settings?tab=trust correctly activates the Trust tab (data-testid='settings-tab-privacy', data-state='active', display text 'Trust') and renders data-testid='trust-centre' section with all 4 numbered cards (01 RESIDENCY 'Your context never leaves this account.', 02 SHIELDING 'Identities are masked before any LLM call.', 03 PROVENANCE, 04 CONTROL). Existing 'Synisense identity shielding' and 'Consent decisions' sections still render below. (3) Source code for all iter17 features is correctly wired: role-mismatch-fix-btn at AppShell.jsx:508, home-nba-card/home-nba-upload/home-nba-generate at AppHome.jsx:~516, lens-run-stage at LensRoom.jsx:325, useAIStageTicker hook present at /app/frontend/src/hooks/useAIStageTicker.js, trust-centre at TenantSettings.jsx:779. ENVIRONMENTAL BLOCKERS (not code bugs): Role-mismatch banner could not be reproduced at runtime because AuthContext bootstrap auto-realigns activeRole to active context's my_role on mount, and top-bar role-switcher-btn triggers handleRoleSwitch which auto-finds a matching context before rendering. NBA card could not be reproduced — a freshly-created executive_personal context renders the 'Finish the board-focused audit to unlock your signals' onboarding gate (progress_state.onboarding_step=0) which takes precedence over EmptySlot; NBA card only shows for audit-complete+no-signals contexts. Lens run stage ticker could not be observed because clicking lens-run-btn did not produce a visible lens-running panel within 12s in my test (no POST /api/lens/run hit in backend log during the test window) — source wiring is correct but the runtime click path appears flaky/blocked; needs manual verification.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking data-testid='trust-footer-link' does not trigger SPA navigation (URL stays on current page despite correct href /app/settings?tab=trust). Direct URL access works perfectly. Tested on /app and /app/briefings — both saw the click no-op. Likely a pointer-events / focus / stopPropagation issue, or the footer sits inside a content pane whose scroll owner swallows the click.

integration_issues.issue: After filling subject (>=10 chars) and clicking data-testid='lens-run-btn' (disabled=False), the data-testid='lens-running' panel never appeared within 12s and no POST /api/lens/run hit the backend during the window. Could be flaky (network or lens catalog selection), or the run actually started but completed before the running panel rendered. The stageScript/useAIStageTicker wiring itself is correct per source. Please verify manually or add a small delay before switching to status='completed'.

integration_issues.flow: Home NBA card on fresh context
integration_issues.issue: A freshly created executive_personal context via POST /api/contexts renders the 'Resume audit' onboarding gate (7-min board-focused audit) instead of the iter17 NextBestActionCard — the audit gate takes precedence over the no-signals/EmptySlot branch. If NBA card is meant to show BEFORE audit completion, the render precedence in AppHome.jsx needs reordering; otherwise the acceptance criterion ('a brand-new test user / fresh context') should be restated as 'audit-complete + no-signals'.

In a live environment, the banner is effectively unreproducible: AuthContext bootstrap realigns activeRole to activeContext.my_role on first mount, and the top-bar role-switcher-btn's handleRoleSwitch auto-finds a matching context before updating. Setting localStorage.akki.activeRole='executive' then reloading does NOT produce the banner — bootstrap realigns before paint. Source code for data-testid='role-mismatch-fix-btn' is present (AppShell.jsx:508) but there is no user-reachable path to trigger it. Consider adding a debug toggle or a way to temporarily suspend auto-realign for manual QA.

action_items: Fix trust-footer-link SPA navigation — clicking the <Link> does not route to /app/settings?tab=trust; investigate pointer-events, z-index on ancestor scroll containers, or nested <main> overflow clipping. Direct URL works, so the route handler is correct.

Verify Lens Room 'Apply lens' actually fires POST /api/lens/run and shows the lens-running panel when clicked programmatically — current test saw the button unlock after subject fill but no run started. Possibly the default selected lens isn't loaded from /api/lens/catalog at time-of-click, or the subject-length threshold differs from 10 chars.

Clarify NBA card render precedence: today the onboarding/audit gate beats EmptySlot on a fresh executive_personal context. If NBA card is meant to show pre-audit, move it ahead of the audit gate in AppHome.jsx; otherwise update the iter17 acceptance test to seed an audit-complete context.
Optional: expose a dev-only way to suspend AuthContext auto-realign of activeRole so QA can reach the role-mismatch banner + fix button at runtime (currently only reachable by inspecting source).
critical_code_review_comments: Trust footer is inside <main> inside AppShell, so pages that own their own internal scroll (Learn, Workspace, Briefings at h-[calc(100vh-4rem)]) push it below the viewport — expected per iter17 notes, but the Link click no-op on those surfaces is a real functional regression for discoverability.

Role-mismatch auto-realign in AuthContext bootstrap + handleRoleSwitch effectively makes the banner dead code in production unless a user is on a context whose my_role strictly does not match any selectable role — consider documenting or adding telemetry so we know if it ever fires.

success_rate.frontend: 60% — 2/5 iter17 features VERIFIED live (Trust footer render, Trust Centre deep link + 4 cards). 1/5 has a real click bug (trust-footer-link SPA nav). 2/5 could not be reproduced at runtime (NBA card gated by audit; role-mismatch auto-realigned). Source code for all 5 is correctly wired.

rca of the issue: trust-footer-link click no-op RCA candidate: <Link> sits inside a <footer> with 'mt-auto' inside a flex-col <main>. On surfaces that own a nested h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] scroller (Briefings, Workspace, Learn), the <main>'s flex doesn't get to the footer's natural flow — the footer does render (visible in screenshots) but may have pointer-events suppressed or be sitting under an overlay. Worth checking: (a) inspect trust-footer's computed z-index and the Link's pointer-events CSS; (b) check if any ancestor has onClick stopPropagation; (c) consider converting <Link> to <button onClick={() => navigate(...)}/> and see if SPA navigation resumes. Direct URL /app/settings?tab=trust works perfectly — Router is fine, only the Link click path is broken.
